name: polyp-vent-kill
description: ACCEPTANCE, target priority / the opening: the facetank funnel with fire held the whole run (?polyp=1 solo stage). The bot parks on post-mid inside the locked lane spraying level rifle shots at the bulb — CONFIG roots the bulb center exactly on the standing firing line, so aim is never the obstacle. While the iris is closed or dilating the shots visibly ping off the armour (a naive DPS race would kill a 6 hp target in under a second; here the kill cannot land before the first volley resolves), the first beam costs the bot one point, and the fire+vent opening that follows is where the kill actually happens — DESIGN's 'destroy it during an opening', measured. Once kills>=1 the x-gate releases and the bot runs out to the rejoin: expected VICTORY, kills 1, hp 2. KNOWN LIMIT (harness, not enemy): the open-loop approach hops fork on dispatch quantization and can jam a run in the chimney or dare pocket (~1 in 7 observed); the run then stalls at x<57 with the polyp never engaged — re-run it.
